subject: Andrews Middle School Virtual Orientation
overview: Principal Mike Downs led a virtual open house for incoming sixth-graders and their families to introduce the school's facilities, staff, and academic expectations. The session included a video tour, a review of administrative procedures, and a panel discussion with faculty members regarding the transition to middle school.

items.title: Welcome and Core Values
items.summary: Principal Mike Downs introduced the faculty and outlined the school's core values of excellence, responsibility, and respect.

items.title: Virtual Building Tour
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent and Principal Downs presented a video tour of the school's cafeteria, gymnasium, tech lab, and outdoor athletic facilities.

items.title: Student Schedules and Academic Overview
items.summary: The principal reviewed sample sixth-grade schedules, detailing the eight-block system, exploratory classes, and the 'What I Need Now' (WINN) period.

items.title: Parent Fact Sheet and Administrative Procedures
items.summary: Downs discussed logistical procedures including the School Brains grading platform, busing schedules, dismissal protocols, and the use of school-issued lockers.

items.title: PTO Overview
items.summary: The presentation highlighted the Parent Teacher Organization's role in fundraising for technology and sponsoring school social events.

items.title: Faculty Panel and Question and Answer
items.summary: Teachers and administrators answered questions regarding intramural sports, club availability, and social equity while offering advice for a successful transition.

items.title: Staff and Student Welcome Video
items.summary: The meeting concluded with a compilation video featuring messages from current students and faculty members welcoming the incoming class.
